---
title: "Embedding Classifier Evaluation — Precision Variants"
---

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(yardstick)
library(rsample)
```

```{r load-predictions}
# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BASE <- out_path("sequence-classifier")

ENSEMBLE_DIRS <- list(
  "LM Exclusion AUGC"      = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-exclusion"),
  "LM Baseline AUGC"       = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-baseline"),
  "LM Exclusion Prec@5%"   = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-exclusion-precision"),
  "LM Baseline Prec@5%"    = file.path(BASE, "ensemble-output-baseline-precision")
)

COMPARATOR_MODELS <- c(
  "junction_kmer_glm",
  "junction_kmer_rf",
  "sequence_kmer_glm",
  "sequence_kmer_rf",
  "junction_protein_glm",
  "junction_protein_rf",
  "vdj_protein_glm",
  "vdj_protein_rf",
  "airr_metadata_glm",
  "patient_metadata_glm"
)

COMPARATOR_LABELS <- c(
  junction_kmer_glm     = "Junction k-mer GLM",
  junction_kmer_rf      = "Junction k-mer RF",
  sequence_kmer_glm     = "Sequence k-mer GLM",
  sequence_kmer_rf      = "Sequence k-mer RF",
  junction_protein_glm  = "Junction protein GLM",
  junction_protein_rf   = "Junction protein RF",
  vdj_protein_glm       = "VDJ protein GLM",
  vdj_protein_rf        = "VDJ protein RF",
  airr_metadata_glm     = "AIRR metadata GLM",
  patient_metadata_glm  = "Patient metadata GLM"
)

COMPARATOR_BASE <- file.path(BASE, "comparator-output")

# ── Helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load_ensemble <- function(dir, model_label) {
  bind_rows(
    read_csv(file.path(dir, "unflipped/predictions/ensemble_predictions.csv"),
             show_col_types = FALSE),
    read_csv(file.path(dir, "flipped/predictions/ensemble_predictions.csv"),
             show_col_types = FALSE)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      `prob_Multiple sclerosis` = ms_score,
      Predicted                 = predicted_class,
      Disease                   = true_label
    ) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label)
}

# ── LM models ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lm_preds <- imap(ENSEMBLE_DIRS, load_ensemble)

# ── Comparator models ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
comp_preds <- map(COMPARATOR_MODELS, function(m) {
  load_ensemble(file.path(COMPARATOR_BASE, m), COMPARATOR_LABELS[[m]])
})

# ── Combine and filter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_preds <-
  c(lm_preds, comp_preds) %>%
  map(select, `prob_Multiple sclerosis`, Disease, Predicted, Author, Subject, model) %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  mutate(
    Predicted = if_else(Predicted == "Multiple sclerosis", "Multiple sclerosis", "Other"),
    Disease   = if_else(Disease   == "Multiple sclerosis", "Multiple sclerosis", "Other")
  ) %>%
  # Remove known duplicate / confounded BioProjects
  filter(Author != "PRJNA248475", Author != "PRJNA248411") %>%
  # Remove MS twins
  mutate(Disease = if_else(str_detect(Subject, "Twin(?:1|2|3|4)\\.2"), "MS Twin", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(str_detect(Subject, "SCNI"),                "MS Twin", Disease)) %>%
  filter(Disease != "MS Twin") %>%
  mutate(
    Disease   = factor(Disease),
    Predicted = factor(Predicted, levels = levels(Disease))
  )
```

```{r model-order}
# Fixed model order: LM variants first (best to worst), then comparators
LM_ORDER <- c(
  "LM Exclusion Prec@5%",
  "LM Baseline Prec@5%",
  "LM Exclusion AUGC",
  "LM Baseline AUGC"
)

COMP_ORDER <- c(
  "Junction k-mer GLM",
  "Junction k-mer RF",
  "Sequence k-mer GLM",
  "Sequence k-mer RF",
  "Junction protein GLM",
  "Junction protein RF",
  "VDJ protein GLM",
  "VDJ protein RF",
  "AIRR metadata GLM",
  "Patient metadata GLM"
)

MODEL_ORDER <- c(LM_ORDER, COMP_ORDER)

MODEL_COLOURS <- c(
  setNames(
    viridis::viridis(length(LM_ORDER), option = "D", begin = 0.05, end = 0.9),
    LM_ORDER
  ),
  setNames(rep("grey70", length(COMP_ORDER)), COMP_ORDER)
)
```

```{r bootstrapped-auprc}
# Bootstrapped AUPRC — 100 resamples per model
set.seed(42)

auprc_boots <-
  all_preds %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    bootstraps(.x, times = 100) %>%
      mutate(auprc = map_dbl(splits, ~ {
        dat <- analysis(.x)
        pr_auc_vec(dat$Disease, dat$`prob_Multiple sclerosis`)
      }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(MODEL_ORDER)))

ggplot(auprc_boots, aes(x = auprc, y = model, fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MODEL_COLOURS) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid      = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "AUPRC (100 bootstrap resamples)", y = NULL,
       title = "Precision@5% vs AUGC: AUPRC comparison")
```

```{r precision-at-top-k}
# Precision in top X% by predicted MS score — 100 bootstrap resamples
FRACS <- c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01, 0.001)

precision_topk <- function(dat, frac) {
  k   <- max(1L, round(nrow(dat) * frac))
  top <- slice_max(dat, `prob_Multiple sclerosis`, n = k, with_ties = FALSE)
  mean(top$Disease == "Multiple sclerosis")
}

topk_boots <-
  all_preds %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    bootstraps(.x, times = 100) %>%
      mutate(frac = list(FRACS)) %>%
      unnest(frac) %>%
      mutate(precision = map2_dbl(splits, frac, ~ {
        precision_topk(analysis(.x), .y)
      }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pct   = paste0("Top ", frac * 100, "%"),
    pct   = factor(pct, levels = paste0("Top ", FRACS * 100, "%")),
    model = factor(model, levels = rev(MODEL_ORDER))
  )

ggplot(topk_boots, aes(x = precision, y = model, fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~pct, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MODEL_COLOURS) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Precision in top X%", y = NULL,
       title = "Precision@top-k: all models")
```

```{r precision-lm-only}
# Zoomed view — LM variants only, for cleaner comparison
topk_lm <-
  topk_boots %>%
  filter(model %in% LM_ORDER) %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(LM_ORDER)))

ggplot(topk_lm, aes(x = precision, y = model, fill = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~pct, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = MODEL_COLOURS[LM_ORDER]) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Precision in top X%", y = NULL,
       title = "LM variants: Prec@5% objective vs AUGC objective")
```
